text:
ashok: Heads up — seeing ~120 GPU nodes in us-west2 stuck in PROVISIONING after last night's OOB BMC push. Many show secure-boot toggled ON and SEL variable mismatch.

maria: which push? microcode or BMC? any logs?

ashok: bmc-v2.14.3 applied at 02:15 UTC. ipmi shows auth blob mismatch and NVRAM write errors. quick grep: `journalctl -u oob-agent | grep nvram` shows `nvram: write failed - checksum`

sam: oncall is paged? I'll check provisioner. tagging @oncall

oncall: I have nodes 10.3.4.0/24 showing 'secureboot=enabled' though inventory expected disabled. Provisioner rejects PXE boot due to UEFI var not found.

jenny: can we force fallback to older BMC image? rollback runbook?

ashok: rollback path exists but it's slow — reimaging BMC fleet takes ~3-5 min/node serially. If we mass rollback we risk hitting reserved capacity billing spikes and provisioning backlog.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-342 — OOB auth blob / NVRAM failure in us-west2. Link: https://infra-incidents/reports/INC-2026-342 :rotating_light: :eyes:

maria: quick mitigation idea — dual-path: 1) patch provisioner to accept compat-mode (ignore secureboot flag) for this cohort, 2) schedule targeted BMC rollback on nodes failing nvram check. Sam do you have a safe API toggle?

sam: we can flip `provisioner.allow_compat_uefi = true` for tag `oob-2026-02` in config store. I'll draft command:

```
curl -XPOST https://provisioner.internal/api/config \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"provisioner.allow_compat_uefi": true, "scope": "tag:oob-2026-02"}'
```

sam: running now against a canary of 10 nodes. :rocket:

jenny: after canary if good, run through 100 nodes then blast to rest during low-traffic window. Also add alert to detect nvram write errors so we revert quickly. :thumbsup:

oncall: can confirm canary nodes moved to ACTIVE after toggle. still seeing ~8 nodes with tpm/secureboot mismatch — manual inspect needed.

ashok: action items: Sam enable compat toggle (done), Jenny schedule rollback plan and cost check, Maria coordinate with sales re possible impact to dedicated customers (reserved capacity). I'll open cost estimate.

deploy-bot: Deploy `provisioner-config v2026.3.4` rolled out to 1 region (us-west2) by sam at 2026-03-18T03:42Z

jenny: cost note — if we need to reprovision ~1k nodes it could temporarily double outbound network egress to storage and cause ~$18k extra for the month. adding to incident.

ashok: thanks. keeping this thread for runbook updates. ping me if you see nodes flip back to secureboot=enabled. :eyes:
